title_en: Turn Back, Turn Back, Dear Marica
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-sounding song with the transformation motif. 'Мен'' = мене (me), 'ај' here is a filler; 'најг'ста' is my reading of 'най-густа'.

lines.en: - Turn back, turn back, dear Marica,

lines.cyr: ај пред нас има најг'ста гора,
lines.lat: aj pred nas ima najg'sta gora,
lines.en: ahead of us there is a very thick forest,
you won't be able to cross it.

lines.cyr: - Јас ќе се сторам шарено пиле,
lines.lat: - Jas ḱe se storam šareno pile,
lines.en: - I will turn myself into a speckled bird,
I will fly over the forest

lines.cyr: и пак со тебе, либе ќе дојдам
lines.lat: i pak so tebe, libe ḱe dojdam
lines.en: and again I will come to you, love,
- Turn back, turn back, dear Marica,

lines.cyr: ај пред нас има дл'бока река,
lines.lat: aj pred nas ima dl'boka reka,
lines.en: ahead of us there is a deep river,
you won't be able to swim across it.

lines.cyr: - Ќе се претворам во риба мренка,
lines.lat: - Ḱe se pretvoram vo riba mrenka,
lines.en: - I will turn into a barbel fish,
I will swim across the river

lines.cyr: и пак со тебе либе ќе дојдам
lines.lat: i pak so tebe libe ḱe dojdam
lines.en: and again I will come to you, love,
